Hunter Douglas Provenance® Woven Wood Shades

John got his start installing window treatments before opening his California store in 1995. That experience still shapes the advice we give in our Woodland Hills showroom.

Come in to see fabrics and finishes, compare window treatments and talk through your rooms. We’ll help you narrow down the options for light, privacy and the way you want your home to feel.

Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation

Lower several shades together when the afternoon sun arrives, or adjust a tall window from your seat. PowerView® Automation operates selected Hunter Douglas window treatments with a remote or the PowerView® App.

  • Handheld and wall-mounted controls
  • Group compatible shades by room
  • Set schedules in the PowerView® App

John and Max help you choose the controls, confirm any gateway requirements and set up the system at installation.

The PowerView® App is required for programmed operation.

Motorized shade installation and setup

One team to help you choose, measure and install your window treatments.

Consultation & measuring

Tell us about the rooms, the light and privacy you need, and your budget. We’ll help compare suitable products and take the measurements for your quote.

Professional installation

Our team installs your window treatments and checks the fit and operation. You have help from product selection through the final adjustments.

Controls & setup

Choose from the controls available for your shades. We set up the system and show you how to operate it before we finish.

Power & compatibility

We’ll review battery, rechargeable or wired options for your selected product. Tell us about any smart-home system so we can check the equipment needed.
